_doc: Biome-specific feature templates for runtime cell generation. Each terrain type has weighted feature pools. The generation engine rolls 2-5 features per cell from the appropriate pool.

water.name: woodland stream
water.desc: Clear water over mossy stones; drinkable

water.name: hidden spring
water.desc: Bubbles up beneath twisted roots; surprisingly cold

water.name: stagnant pool
water.desc: Dark water; insects hover; something moved beneath

natural.name: ancient oak
natural.desc: Trunk wider than three men; carvings half-absorbed by bark

natural.name: mushroom ring
natural.desc: Perfect circle of pale caps; ether-touched or mundane?

natural.name: rocky outcrop
natural.desc: Boulders thrust from earth; good vantage point

natural.name: fallen giant
natural.desc: Massive trunk blocks the path; hollow interior large enough to shelter in

natural.name: dense thicket
natural.desc: Thorny undergrowth; impassable without cutting or crawling

structures.name: woodcutter's ruin
structures.desc: Stone foundation and chimney; roof long collapsed

structures.name: old waystone
structures.desc: Carved marker from a vanished road; moss-covered glyphs

structures.name: hunter's blind
structures.desc: Platform nailed between trees; rotting but climbable

structures.name: druid circle
structures.desc: Standing stones in a clearing; flowers grow between regardless of season

historical.name: battlefield bones
historical.desc: Scattered remains half-buried in leaf litter; armor fragments

historical.name: abandoned camp
historical.desc: Cold fire pit, torn canvas, drag marks into the brush

historical.name: ward-stone
historical.desc: Carved with protective sigils; still faintly warm to touch

ether.name: glowing moss
ether.desc: Patches of bioluminescent growth; brighter near thin-veil areas

ether.name: whispering hollow
ether.desc: Voices carry from within the trunk of a dead tree; nonsense words

water.name: deep pool
water.desc: Murky water of unknown depth; reeds hide the edge

water.name: bubbling vent
water.desc: Sulfurous gas rises from underwater; smells of rot

water.name: peat stream
water.desc: Tea-dark water flowing sluggishly; tastes of earth

natural.name: hummock island
natural.desc: Raised mound of solid ground amid bog; rare dry footing

natural.name: dead tree stand
natural.desc: Skeletal trunks rising from water; roots provide footholds

natural.name: reed maze
natural.desc: Tall reeds block sight in every direction; easy to get turned around

natural.name: sinkhole
natural.desc: Ground gives way without warning; test each step

structures.name: causeway pylons
structures.desc: Stone pillars of a sunken road; path between them is passable at low water

structures.name: sunken shrine
structures.desc: Half-submerged stonework; offerings of bone and cord hang from exposed beams

structures.name: stilt platform
structures.desc: Wooden platform on rotting stilts; recent repairs suggest use

historical.name: mireling burrow
historical.desc: Packed-mud tunnel entrance; scraping sounds from within

historical.name: pre-Sundering column
historical.desc: Carved stone rising from the muck; glyphs illegible from erosion

historical.name: sunken bones
historical.desc: Peat-preserved remains visible through water; delver gear still attached

ether.name: will-o-wisp trail
ether.desc: Faint lights drift over the water; following them leads deeper into the fen

ether.name: green glow pool
ether.desc: Bioluminescent — or ether bleed? The water is warm

ether.name: echo mist
ether.desc: Fog that repeats sounds from hours or days past

water.name: village well
water.desc: Stone-lined; bucket and rope in good repair

water.name: irrigation ditch
water.desc: Channels water from a distant source; muddy banks

water.name: pond
water.desc: Livestock watering hole; geese patrol the bank

natural.name: hedgerow
natural.desc: Dense boundary between fields; berries in season

natural.name: lone elm
natural.desc: Shade tree at field center; initials carved in bark

natural.name: wildflower patch
natural.desc: Untilled corner bursting with color; bees everywhere

structures.name: stone wall
structures.desc: Dry-stacked boundary wall; old and well-maintained

structures.name: barn ruin
structures.desc: Collapsed roof; weathered timbers; stored hay rotting

structures.name: mile marker
structures.desc: Registry stone with distance to nearest settlement

structures.name: shrine
structures.desc: Small roadside altar; fresh flowers suggest regular visitors

historical.name: old fortification
historical.desc: Ash Century earthwork repurposed as sheep pen

historical.name: burial mound
historical.desc: Grassy hillock; locals know not to dig here

historical.name: abandoned cottage
historical.desc: Intact but empty; belongings left mid-meal

ether.name: crop circle
ether.desc: Perfect geometric pattern in the wheat; appeared overnight

water.name: roadside spring
water.desc: Clean water piped into a stone trough; traveler's blessing

water.name: bridge crossing
water.desc: Stone arch over a stream; worn smooth by centuries of traffic

natural.name: shade trees
natural.desc: Planted in a line; deliberate rest stop from a bygone era

natural.name: rockslide
natural.desc: Fresh debris narrows the road; passable on foot but not by cart

structures.name: waystation
structures.desc: Roof, fire ring, and hitching post; no walls

structures.name: toll ruin
structures.desc: Gatehouse with no gate; arrow slits watch empty road

structures.name: mile post
structures.desc: Registry marker with distances to major settlements

structures.name: merchant camp
structures.desc: Fire ring, wheel ruts, scattered feed — recently departed

historical.name: gallows tree
historical.desc: Iron cage swings from a branch; empty now

historical.name: war memorial
historical.desc: Names carved in stone; too many to read

ether.name: flickering signpost
ether.desc: The destination text changes when you're not looking directly

water.name: hillside spring
water.desc: Crystal water flows from between rocks; ice cold

water.desc: Natural basin in stone; fills after rain, dry otherwise

natural.desc: Scattered stones from an ancient rockslide; good cover

natural.desc: Bare hilltop; can see for miles in clear weather

natural.name: ravine
natural.desc: Deep cut in the hillside; difficult to cross without rope

natural.name: cave entrance
natural.desc: Dark opening in the hillside; animal den or more?

structures.name: shepherd's bothy
structures.desc: Stone shelter with turf roof; dry inside

structures.name: watchtower base
structures.desc: First three stories of a tower; stairs end at sky

structures.name: cairn
structures.desc: Stacked stones marking a path or a grave

historical.name: mine entrance
historical.desc: Timber-framed opening; partially collapsed. Ore veins visible

historical.name: hill fort earthwork
historical.desc: Concentric ditches from a pre-Registry defense; overgrown but clear from above

ether.name: standing stone
ether.desc: Single monolith on the hilltop; hums at dawn and dusk

water.name: waterfall
water.desc: Cascade dropping into mist below; roar drowns conversation

water.name: cliff seep
water.desc: Water weeps from rock face; mineral stains mark the flow

natural.name: ledge path
natural.desc: Narrow trail along the cliff face; exposed to wind

natural.desc: Birds crowd every ledge; guano coats the stone

structures.name: rope bridge
structures.desc: Swaying span between cliffs; some planks missing

structures.name: carved steps
structures.desc: Chiseled into the rock face; ancient and worn smooth

structures.name: hermit cave
structures.desc: Modified natural cavity; smoke-stained ceiling, sleeping niche

historical.name: abandoned nest
historical.desc: Something large nested here; shed scales or feathers remain

historical.name: cliff tomb
historical.desc: Sealed chamber cut into the rock face; ward-marks on the door

ether.name: lightning scar
ether.desc: Glass-smooth furrow in the stone; faint static charge remains

ether.name: echo point
ether.desc: Words spoken here return minutes later, sometimes altered

water.name: ice lake
water.desc: Frozen surface; dark shapes visible beneath the ice

water.name: thermal vent
water.desc: Steam rises from cracked earth; warm circle in the snow

natural.name: ice formation
natural.desc: Wind-carved pillars of ice; beautiful and treacherous

natural.name: snow drift
natural.desc: Deep accumulation; hides terrain features and possibly dangers

ether.name: frost shimmer
ether.desc: Air distortion like heat haze, but freezing cold; ether interface

ether.name: preserved whispers
ether.desc: Sounds frozen in the air; warming them releases old voices

water.name: tidal pool
water.desc: Trapped sea life between rocks; some bioluminescent at night

water.name: freshwater inlet
water.desc: Stream meets sea; brackish but drinkable upstream

natural.name: sea cave
natural.desc: Accessible at low tide; floods at high. Echoes strangely

natural.name: driftwood pile
natural.desc: Storm debris; firewood and occasionally something useful

natural.name: sand dunes
natural.desc: Shifting hills of sand; paths change with wind

structures.name: beached hull

structures.desc: Stone trap for fish; maintained by nearby villagers

water.desc: Underground water storage; cracked but partially full

water.desc: Water-filled basement accessible through collapsed floor

natural.name: overgrown courtyard
natural.desc: Nature reclaiming stone; roots crack walls

natural.name: collapsed section
natural.desc: Rubble pile; might be passable with care

structures.desc: Standing masonry; provides shelter from wind

structures.name: gate arch
structures.desc: Entrance to nothing; the rest is rubble

structures.desc: First floor of what was tall; spiral stairs go nowhere

structures.name: vault entrance
structures.desc: Heavy door, sealed or jammed; leads underground

historical.name: inscription wall
historical.desc: Carved text in old script; partially legible

historical.name: shattered idol
historical.desc: Pieces of a large statue; deity unidentifiable

historical.name: trapped corridor
historical.desc: Mechanism still active despite centuries of decay

ether.desc: Shadows replay old events at certain hours; harmless but unsettling

natural.desc: Ancient specimen in the square; meetings held beneath it

structures.name: inn
structures.desc: Rest and rumors; ale quality varies

structures.name: smithy
structures.desc: Forge heat and hammer ring; repairs and basic weapons

structures.desc: Supplies, rations, rope, lanterns — the essentials

structures.name: temple
structures.desc: Place of worship; healing services may be available

structures.name: Registry office
structures.desc: Map stamps, claim filings, death registrations

historical.name: war memorial
historical.desc: Names of the fallen; sobering reminder

historical.name: old quarter
historical.desc: Oldest buildings; architecture from a different era

ether.name: ward boundary
ether.desc: Chalk marks on buildings; protective magic maintained weekly

water.desc: Shallow depression collects rainwater; animal tracks converge

historical.desc: Weapons and bones surface after heavy rain

historical.name: nomad campsite
historical.desc: Fire ring and tent-stake holes; used seasonally

ether.desc: Perfect ring where nothing grows; ground is warm

water.desc: Crystal clear and freezing; fed by snowmelt

water.name: glacier runoff
water.desc: Milky-white water rushing over stones; loud

natural.desc: Loose rock; every step sends stones tumbling

natural.desc: Brief flat area between peaks; wildflowers in summer

natural.desc: Only way through for miles; ambush territory
